spec.scene: A small tiled balcony patch with a low railing and a round table at the center. On the table sits the lopsided peach galette, a little larger than life, beside a paper bag of peaches and a crusty sourdough loaf. A bundle of deep-purple carrots leans at the front edge. A phone propped against a mug glows warm at the right, showing a tiny colorful kitchen. Near the back edge a small figure in a blue jacket holds a market tote. Honey-gold light washes the tiles and railing.
spec.title: Galette at Golden Hour
spec.caption: Ugly galette, golden balcony light, and Mom on the phone — perfect. We made it together. Mom and I made an ugly galette and ate it in the golden light.
